title: Effective geometric ergodicty for Markov chains in random environment
summary: In this short note we prove ``effective" geometric ergodicity (i.e a Perron-Frobenius theorem) for Markov chains in random mixing dynamical environment satisfying a random non-uniform version of the Doeblin condition. Effectivity here means that all the random variables involved in the random exponential rates are integrable with arbitrarily large order. This compliments \cite[Theorem 2.1]{Kifer 1996}, where ``non-effective" geometric ergodicity was obtained.
